title: A Phase 1/2 study of ARV-6723 as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab in participants with advanced solid tumors
official: A Phase 1/2 Open-label Study to Evaluate Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Preliminary Anti-tumor Activity of ARV-6723 Administered as Monotherapy and in Combination with Pembrolizumab in Participants with Advanced Solid Tumors
summary:
Main objective: Part A1: 
To evaluate the safety and tolerability of ARV-6723 as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab in successive cohorts of participants with advanced solid tumors, to select doses for Phase 1b dose optimization.

Part A2:
To determine the RP2D for ARV-6723 as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab, respectively, based on evaluation of safety and tolerability, and preliminary antitumour activitiy.

interventions.name: KEYTRUDA 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. ≥18 years of age with advanced solid tumors
2. Histologic or cytologic diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic solid tumor malignancy
3. Previously on at least one prior therapy targeting PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, and/or another T-cell co-stimulatory or immune checkpoint pathway, in any treatment setting (including neoadjuvant or adjuvant)
4. At least one prior standard of care (SOC) therapy appropriate for their disease
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active brain metastasis
2. Carcinomatous meningitis
3. Carcinomatous meningitis, participants with any other active malignancy within 2 years prior to enrollment/randomization
4. Known or suspected hypersensitivity to ARV-6723 or pembrolizumab or any of its excipients
5. Active autoimmune disease or history of autoimmune diseases that may relapse
